App: QuantPlayer – Desktop Windows
Feature/Bug Tested:
Suggestion: When reaching the end of each list (Home, Movies, Series, Movie Details, Series Details), the navigation arrow pointing to the next item should not remain visible, similar to the behavior on the first item of the section.

 Test Result
The test was executed on 02/18/2026, and the fix was FAILED.

Issues Found

Trailer List Issue

When the user reaches the end or the beginning of the trailer list, the navigation arrow (next/previous) is still displayed.

The arrow should be hidden when there are no more items available for navigation.

Same Behavior in Other Categories
The same issue occurs across all movie and series lists, including:

Movies 
Series

The navigation arrows remain visible even when the user is at the boundary (first or last item) of the list.

App: QuantPlayer – Desktop Windows
Feature/Bug Tested:
[SUGGESTION] – The channel preview pause and resume should accept interactions at its center.

Test Result

The test was executed on 02/18/2026, and the fix was FAILED.

Details

This is a business rule adjustment.

Currently, when the user moves the mouse over the mini player and/or in full screen mode, the central pause/play button becomes visible and remains visible for a period of time — even if the player is already running. Simply hovering the mouse over the screen triggers the button to appear.

Current Behavior:

Moving the mouse over the player displays the central pause/play button.

The button remains visible for a few seconds, even without user interaction (click).

This occurs in both mini player and full screen modes.

Expected Behavior:

The central pause/play button should become visible only when the user clicks on the screen.

After approximately 5 seconds, the button should automatically disappear if there is no further interaction.

The current implementation does not follow the expected interaction rule and therefore the validation is FAILED.
